PostToolUse._comment: Logs a design-tool WRITE for gate accounting. Matches ONLY tools that change a design. Deliberately excludes create_new_file (produces an EMPTY file — nothing to gate) and upload_assets (puts a file in the library; it is not a creative until something places it). Anchored so a tool whose name merely contains one of these substrings cannot match. Widen for your own design tool.

Stop._comment: Blocks ending a session with ungated builds. Loop-guarded; the human can waive it with a .gates/<date>-skipped.md note.
